metadata.title: Contrails vs “Chemtrails”: What Those White Streaks Really Are
metadata.description:
Airplane “chemtrails”? Experts explain they’re contrails—normal condensation trails formed when hot jet exhaust meets cold air at high altitude. Contrails are mainly water/ice, and are not the intentional release of metals or chemicals. They don’t affect the quality of air, water, or food—and don’t pose a risk to your health.

🧭 Timestamps 
00:00 Canadians ask about “chemtrails” 
00:35 What contrails are: hot exhaust + cold air 
00:50 Why contrails persist or fade: temperature and humidity 
01:10 What they’re made of: water/ice—no intentional chemicals or metals 
01:26 Health and environment: no impact on air, water, or food quality 
01:48 Look for credible, science based sources

📚 Learn More : https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/air-quality.html 
https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/science-research.html

#AirQuality #Contrails #ScienceFacts #PublicHealth #MythBusting
